entries.statement: A source's exact first_public_at must be known down to the hour for ANY leakage-avoiding daily historical analysis
entries.scope: 2023 BOE ordinary editions under Article 11 RD181 and 2023 publisher annual compliance report
evidence_for: Precise instantaneous event-based backtests require genuine first_public_at and archives where available.
evidence_against: AEBOE 2023 reported 312/312 ordinary issues published by 08:00 on dated issue day; article 11 guarantees same-day availability unless extraordinary technical problem. Signed publisher original PDFs under issue-level 2023 dates.
entries.update: Use conservative next-day local cutoff for 2023 ordinary BOE documents; classify as legal/publisher-reported availability tier, not per-record observed first-public timestamp.
entries.uncertainty: Agency ex-post reporting, technical outage exception, signed PDF SHA1 and expired cert without full historical trust validation. This does not cover Senate/Congress.

entries.statement: Normalized names recurring after ≥35 years and more than one constituency necessarily indicate different persons
entries.scope: Entire original 5600 Interior XLSX, three qualifying labels
evidence_against: Planas, García-Margallo, Gil Lázaro each directly source-linked via official Congress/Moncloa biographies across distant legislatures despite changed codes, provinces or party labels.
entries.update: Career span/province/party changes are not identity negatives without independent issuer evidence. Keep 3 curated same-person positives.

entries.statement: Normalized election names spanning 20–34 years and changing province provide reliable hard homonym negatives
entries.scope: 17 original XLSX label candidates, 8 fixed top ranked
evidence_against: Eight fixed names source-linked as same elected politician by original Parliament cross-history, including PSOE/PP/Vox changes and constituency moves.
entries.update: Add 8 positive controls; exact full-name different-person negative remains unfilled. Do not infer population specificity.

entries.statement: Equality of birth date is a hard necessary criterion for identical historical identity when both official publishers provide DOB
entries.scope: Cristina Narbona Ruiz public official biographies across Moncloa, Congreso and PSOE (2008–2024), prior source discovery of 21 vs 29 July 1951
evidence_for: DOB remains one useful corroborating attribute when independently sourced and consistent.
evidence_against: Moncloa 2008 and 2012 claim 1951-07-21; Congreso XV and PSOE 2017/2024 claim 1951-07-29 for public officeholder with identical term biography. Same publisher later copies not independent.
entries.update: Never automatically split when one biographical field conflicts; preserve per-publisher source and all alternatives, flag conflict for adjudication. Do not majority-vote canonical DOB.
entries.uncertainty: Which date legally correct unverified; cannot estimate error prevalence.

entries.statement: Multi-source contradictory attributes can be represented without automatically assigning a person equivalence
entries.scope: Standalone Python identity_field_conflicts.py + 11 local tests; one real public documentary case
evidence_for: Five source assertions, three editorial lineages, two dates retained; malformed/duplicate input rejected and merge/split/release always false.
evidence_against: No evidence that this standalone module resolves exact historical personal identity or provides independently signed source-authentic proofs.
entries.update: Accept pure conflict preservation into AB-P prototype. Future server integration and official adjudication remain blocked.

epistemic_rule: External source evidence and exploratory samples do not become confirmatory AB-R experiments or automatically change a quantitative prior without elicitation.
